overview.description: The Horizon International Managed Risk ETF (SFTX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund shifts allocations between non-US large-cap equities and US short-term fixed income based on market volatility, while employing an options strategy. SFTX was launched on Dec 2, 2025 and is issued by Horizon Kinetics.
